headline: Put purpose at the centre of the student journey.
intro: The course remains the academic foundation of a King's education. King's Edge connects learning, experiences, opportunities and support around what each student wants to understand, become and contribute.
purposeNote: Purpose is not a fixed career plan. It can be uncertain, personal and change over time.

why.title: Students need more than a collection of opportunities.
why.statement: A degree still matters, but it no longer guarantees economic security. Students, including international students making a substantial personal and financial investment, need a coherent experience that helps them develop, make informed choices and show the value of what they have learned.

difference.title: Connect the wider experience around the student.
difference.intro: The conventional university journey starts with the course and adds careers, skills and wider opportunities around its edges. King's Edge keeps the course at the centre of academic life, but joins the wider experience around each student's developing purpose.

mechanisms.title: Four things have to happen.
mechanisms.intro: The model is simple to explain, but demanding to deliver consistently across King's.

items.title: Strengthen the experience
items.statement: Improve the quality and reach of the learning, experiences and opportunities students encounter.

items.title: Connect the experience
items.statement: Help students see how their course, wider experiences and possible futures fit together.

items.title: Support good choices
items.statement: Help students work out what matters to them and find relevant next steps at the right time.

items.title: Recognise and improve
items.statement: Help students show what they have learned, and use the evidence to improve what King's provides.
A clearer, fairer journey and credible evidence of what they know, can do and contribute.
Better insight and shared tools to strengthen distinctive disciplinary provision.
A stronger understanding of where the student experience is working, where it is uneven and where to act.

items.title: Led by faculties
items.statement: Faculties own disciplinary interpretation and enhancement. Central teams provide shared evidence, systems and support.

items.title: For every student
items.statement: Access and benefit should not depend on course, background, confidence, networks or spare time.

items.title: Built and tested in stages
items.statement: King's will develop shared capabilities progressively, learn from use and scale what proves valuable.

aim.statement: Every student can access, understand and show the value of their King's education.

delivery.title: See how the work is being mobilised.
delivery.statement: Explore the projects and deliverables through which King's Edge will test and build this approach.
